maria: Quick update 1 heads-up: legal moved the embargo to 09:00 PT tomorrow (not 10). Need people to confirm any schedule conflicts.

kevin: Wait, my calendar has 10:00. Who changed it?

legal-bot: Embargo update: window revised to 09:00 PT after partner request. Change approved by legal@redwood. Please re-sync schedules.

olivia: That impacts APAC socials. We had planned APAC for T+15 to catch morning. If we move to 09:00 PT, APAC will be mid-evening local. Can we stagger?

ben: I can stagger. Plan: US social at T+5, UK at T+30, APAC at T+90. Keeps press pickup manageable.

maria: OK ben please update the social queue. Also update the calendar event time to 09:00 and ping partners with waivers.

research: Minor note: please use the approved hero line "Up to 3x token throughput on production LLMs" — remove duplicate "real-world" phrasing in the headline. Methodology link stays the same.

press-bot: Assets detected: s3://redwood-assets/optimize/benchmark-pack-v1.2.zip checksum=sha256:abc123 (uploaded by tom)

tom: Shortlinks done and in tracker. Added a column for waiver=yes/no per partner. Partner Z requested earlier publish; marked waiver=yes.

maria: Thanks. Final checklist for this thread: 1) calendar time updated (maria) 2) social schedule updated (ben) 3) partners pinged about new time (maria/tom) 4) headline wording confirmed (research). Reply here once done.

kevin: Calendar updated and 09:00 invite sent.

ben: Social queue updated.

tom: Partners pinged; waiver column updated.

maria: Great work. I'll monitor overnight and escalate if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
